infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: WhoOwes uses the camera to scan receipts so you don't have to type every item.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: WhoOwes reads receipt photos you choose so it can split them for you.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: WhoOwes checks your contacts to show which friends are already on WhoOwes. Numbers are hashed on your phone and never stored.
